// diagnostic

E3204

Two different `use` forms refer to the same C library `{lib}`.

What

Two different `use` forms refer to the same C library `{lib}`.

Why

S59 allows one bring-in per C lib per file — either `use "{header}" as alias` or `use c.[{lib} as alias]`, not both.

Fix

remove one line; keep the form that matches your workflow.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3204: tests/ui/cffi_e3204_two_use_forms.stderr.

Error [E3204]: two different `use` forms refer to the same C library `demo`
  --> tests/ui/cffi_e3204_two_use_forms.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | use "demo.h" as header_api
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Jet allows one bring-in per C lib per file — either `use "demo.h" as alias`, `use c.demo as alias`, or `use c.[demo as alias]`, not both
 Fix: remove one line; keep the form that matches your workflow
